name: Havells India Ltd

business.about: Havells India Limited is a leading Fast Moving Electrical Goods (FMEG) Company and a major power distribution equipment manufacturer with a strong global presence. It enjoys enviable market dominance across a wide spectrum of products, including Industrial & Domestic Circuit Protection Devices, Cables & Wires, Motors, Fans, Modular Switches, Home Appliances, Air Conditioners, Electric Water Heaters, Power Capacitors, Luminaires for Domestic, Commercial and Industrial Applications. [1]
business.key_points: Product Segments [1] [2] [3] The company offers 24 products verticals, under the following segments: 1) Cables (~39% in FY26 vs ~33% in FY25): The company offers flexible and power cables including multicore round cable, flat submersible cable, LAN cable, CCTV, speaker cable, etc. 2) Lloyd Consumer (~18% in FY26 vs ~24% in FY25): Lloyd offers air conditioners, washing machines, refrigerators and televisions. 3) Electrical Consumer Durables (~17% in  FY26 vs ~18% in FY25): It offers fans, appliances and water heaters. 4) Switchgears (~12% in FY26 vs 11% in FY25): The company offers domestic switchgears, capacitors, switches, industrial switchgears, etc. 5) Lighting & Fixtures (~7% in FY26 vs ~8% in FY25): Comprises of professional and consumer luminaries including Home Art lights, LED panels, LED Cobs, lamps, batten, etc. [4] 6) Others (~8% in FY26 vs ~24% in FY25): Includes motors, solar, pump & water purifiers, personal grooming products, etc.

bull.point: Q2 FY27 revenue rebounded sharply with a 34.6% YoY increase to ₹6,432 crore
Annual sales consistently expanded from ₹13,938 crore in FY22 to ₹22,528 crore in FY26
Lighting segment contribution margin outperformed long-term target reaching 37% in Q4 FY26

bear.point: Q1 FY27 OPM dropped to 7.0%, generating a 16.7% decline in PAT YoY

verdict: Havells delivers top-line volume growth and sales recovery, but operating margins consistently lag behind medium-term margin expansion promises.
